scope: Infrastructure aggregate artifact lifecycle on malformed metadata

before.observation: A non-array shard inventory caused reconciliation to throw; the process failed but the previous aggregate.json still reported passed.

after.behavior: Each malformed inventory or file-list case starts with a genuine passing result and verifies replacement with failed aggregate, success=false and incomplete execution.

limitations: Local actual-runner artifact regression; not native candidate CI or full-plan completion.
Unreconciled aggregate counts are null rather than presented as trustworthy totals.
